items.problem: CS0579 'Duplicate ...Attribute' build failures caused by stale UWP obj/bin .cs artifacts (nested under a background-task subfolder) being copied into the project and compiled by the SDK default glob.
items.evidence: session-log.txt: two failed builds (CS0579 x multiple) referencing Tasks\obj\...\.NETCore,Version=v5.0.AssemblyAttributes.cs and obj\...\ActivitySensor.AssemblyInfo.cs; lessons.json errors_encountered + dev_agent_struggles.
items.root_cause: Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1 step 1 (source-file copy) lacked the bin/obj/.vs/.uwp-source/.git exclusion that the later namespace-rewrite step already uses, so stale build artifacts entered the target tree; the SDK only auto-excludes the project's own root obj/bin, not nested ones.
items.change: Add an exclusion (bin, obj, .uwp-source, .vs, .git, .github, .copilot) to the file-copy Where-Object in Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1 so stale build artifacts are never copied into the migrated project.
items.expected_effect: Stale obj/bin .cs files never reach the project; the SDK default glob no longer compiles duplicate assembly attributes; no CS0579 and no reactive <Compile Remove> needed.
items.falsifiable_check: On a re-run of any UWP source containing obj/bin (especially a nested background-task subfolder), the initial dotnet build produces 0 CS0579 errors and the migrated tree contains no copied files under any obj\ or bin\ path.

items.problem: When stale obj/bin still arrives by some other path (hand-copied tree, regenerated nested obj, or a carried-over Properties\AssemblyInfo.cs), the agent has no documented diagnosis for the resulting CS0579.
items.evidence: Grep of SKILL.md / MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md found no CS0579 / AssemblyInfo / DefaultItemExcludes guidance; dev-agent spent 2 build iterations rediscovering it and applied a scenario-specific fix.
items.root_cause: No documented build-error entry for duplicate assembly attributes / nested obj globbing.
items.change: Add a 'CS0579: Duplicate ...Attribute' entry to the 'Common build errors' section of MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md: explain the nested-obj root cause, prefer deleting stray obj/bin, give the DefaultItemExcludes=**/obj/**;**/bin/** guard, and note removing a carried-over UWP Properties\AssemblyInfo.cs.
items.expected_effect: If CS0579 ever surfaces, the agent diagnoses and fixes it in one step instead of iterating, and avoids a hardcoded per-folder <Compile Remove>.
items.falsifiable_check: On a re-run that hits CS0579, the agent cites the new pattern and resolves it in a single edit (no repeated failed builds).
